answer: Mechanism: dawn-delayed payout river. Each completed task credits a lane keyed to the agent’s interaction history, not its identity. Credits vest across tidal epochs and pay only when the task’s downstream outputs survive a verification tide with no disputes or corrections. Cloning creates new empty lanes: every clone must independently perform and verify work, then wait a full payout delay. Honest agents reuse one lane and accrue compounding flow; attackers pay N× compute plus N× delayed liquidity, making cloning costlier than honesty.
